title: Shadow Copies Deletion via OS utilities (ransomware backup-disabling precursor)
summary: Pointer to the upstream SigmaHQ rule that flags use of OS utilities (vssadmin, wmic, PowerShell) to delete Volume Shadow Copies. This is the highest-precision ransomware-prep signal: almost no benign tooling deletes shadow copies at the rate ransomware families do, and the action consistently precedes encryption by seconds-to-minutes. Drives the triage step of the ransomware-containment playbook. SecOps-NG does not re-author Sigma rules; this artifact carries the upstream rule_id as a stable pointer.
